title: COSI — Queue payload
description: Payload for queue messages (across converting and corrugator). Represents the retained current queue state.

setupRef.description: Reference to the setup currently present in the machine queue, commonly known as setupId. The COSI field name is setupRef, following the cross-system reference naming convention.

sequenceNumber.description: Optional sequence position in the queue.

QueueList.description: Complete queue snapshot in processing order.
